Parsers / QRPayBiz (Maybank Quick Merchant)

QRPayBiz (Maybank Quick Merchant)

Untested — help us with real samples v1 By PayPing Community
Download .json

Parser Rules (1)

qrpaybiz.received.v1
Priority: 200 Money In
Match Title:
QRPay Payment Notification|QRPayBiz
Extract amount:
-?\s?(?:RM|MYR)\s?-?\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+\.?\d{0,2})
Extract counterparty:
from (?<counterparty>.+?)(?:\.| Reference|$)
Extract reference:
Reference No(?:: |:| )(?<reference>[A-Z0-9]+)

How to Import in App

  1. Click Copy JSON above.
  2. Open PayPing Lite on your phone.
  3. Open the Bank Rules tab.
  4. Tap + Add Bank Rule and paste.

Report an Issue / New Samples

If your bank modified their notification phrasing or if this parser missed a transaction, please share an anonymised sample!

Submit on GitHub

Raw JSON Definition

{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "id": "qrpaybiz",
  "name": "QRPayBiz (Maybank Quick Merchant)",
  "version": 1,
  "description": "Synthetic starter patterns; not yet validated against real notifications.",
  "androidPackages": ["com.maybank.quickmerchant"],
  "iosAppNames": ["QRPayBiz", "Maybank Quick Merchant"],
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "qrpaybiz.received.v1",
      "priority": 200,
      "match": { "title": "QRPay Payment Notification|QRPayBiz" },
      "direction": "in",
      "extract": {
        "amount": "-?\\s?(?:RM|MYR)\\s?-?\\s?(?<amount>[\\d,]+\\.?\\d{0,2})",
        "counterparty": "from (?<counterparty>.+?)(?:\\.| Reference|$)",
        "reference": "Reference No(?:: |:| )(?<reference>[A-Z0-9]+)"
      }
    }
  ]
}
